sources.title: GitHub - stanford-oval/Churro: CHURRO is an OCR toolkit for historical ...
sources.snippet: 🤗 Model • 🗂️ Dataset • 📄 Paper 📚 Docs • 🏆 Leaderboard • Churro is the fastest way to turn hard-to-read historical scans into reliable text. It gives researchers, libraries, archives, and product teams a unified OCR toolkit for handwritten and printed sources, combining high accuracy, low operating cost, and a clean Python API and CLI workflow.

sources.title: Churro: Making History Readable with an Open-Weight Large Vision ...
sources.snippet: This paper presents Churro, a 3B-parameter open-weight VLM specialized for historical text recognition. The model is trained on Churro-DS 1, the largest historical text recognition dataset to date.

sources.title: Churro: Historical Text Recognition Model
sources.snippet: Churro is an open 3B-parameter vision-language model fine-tuned on Churro-DS to transcribe complex historical documents with high accuracy and cost-efficiency.
